SARIF Schema
============

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is vendored for deterministic local test validation.

Source: https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json

Version: SARIF 2.1.0 Errata 01 OS.

Tests must load this local file and must not fetch the schema at runtime.
